description_en: Retrieves details about a dynamic route in your Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 获取当前阿里云账号下指定动态路由的详情信息
name: GetDynamicRoute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the dynamic route
parameters.name: dynamic_route_id

ApplicationIds.description_en: The list of internal network application IDs for the dynamic route. This field appears only when ApplicationType is set to Application
ApplicationIds.description_zh: 动态路由的内网访问应用ID集合。当应用类型为Application时，该字段有值

items.description_en: An internal network application ID for the dynamic route
items.description_zh: 动态路由的内网访问应用ID

ApplicationType.description_en:
The application type for the dynamic route. Valid values:

All: All applications.

Application: An application.

Tag: A tag
ApplicationType.description_zh:
动态路由的应用类型。取值：
All：全部应用。
Application：应用。
Tag：标签

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the dynamic route was created

Description.description_en: A description of the dynamic route

DynamicRouteId.description_en: The ID of the dynamic route

DynamicRouteType.description_en: The type of the dynamic route. Valid value: connector (dedicated line)
DynamicRouteType.description_zh: 动态路由类型。取值：connector：自有专线

Name.description_en: The name of the dynamic route

NextHop.description_en: The instance ID of the next hop for the dynamic route

Priority.description_en: The priority of the dynamic route. A value of 1 indicates the highest priority. Priority order matches the display order in lists
Priority.description_zh: 动态路由优先级。数字1表示优先级最高。优先级排序和列表查询从上到下保持一致

RegionIds.description_en: The list of regions supported by the SASE POP cluster access points
RegionIds.description_zh: SASE的POP集群接入点支持的地域列表

items.description_en: A region supported by the SASE POP cluster access points
items.description_zh: SASE的POP集群接入点支持的地域

Status.description_en:
The status of the dynamic route. Valid values:

Enabled: The dynamic route is enabled.

Disabled: The dynamic route is disabled
Status.description_zh:
动态路由状态。取值：
Enabled：开启。
Disabled：关闭

TagIds.description_en: The list of internal network tag IDs for the dynamic route. This field appears only when ApplicationType is set to Tag
TagIds.description_zh: 动态路由的内网访问标签ID集合。当应用类型为Tag时，该字段有值

items.description_en: An internal network tag ID for the dynamic route
items.description_zh: 动态路由的内网访问标签ID
